exposure: Primary reasons for referral (hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, previous cesarean section, PPH)
cohort: The study included all referred patients with obstetric indications above 20 weeks gestation and patients with postpartum indications at Government Medical College, Mahasamund, between July 2022 and June 2023.
finding: Illiteracy, ignorance of females regarding healthcare requirements, and poor infrastructure were identified as major contributors to poor pregnancy outcomes among referred cases.
